build_layout_predictor: build a document layout predictor using OpenVINO model to detect page elements like tables, text, and images
run_layout_prediction: run layout prediction on a PIL image or numpy array to yield bounding boxes with labels and confidence scores
initialize_openvino_model: initialize an OpenVINO model with preprocessing pipeline for document layout inference
post_process_detections: post-process object detection scores, labels, and boxes by filtering with a confidence threshold
get_predictor_info: get configuration info including device, num_threads, image_size, and threshold from a LayoutPredictor instance
